decision: Shift content mix to 60% comparison-format articles on Dev.to targeting high-intent tool-evaluation search terms, while eliminating opinion content entirely.
rationale: The only measurable signal is 75 npm downloads suggesting organic discovery from people actively evaluating AI tools — comparison content on Dev.to scored 40 vs Bluesky's 18, directly matching this buyer-intent behavior. Opinion posts show negative conversion and should be cut. Doubling down on comparison content captures readers already in the decision funnel.
